---
title: "Shark Attacks"
---

The Global Shark Attack File (GSAF) is a public database of reported shark-human incidents from around the world. Its records include details such as where and when an incident happened, what activity was underway, and its outcome.

Sharks can be frightening, but serious attacks are rare. Because dramatic incidents receive attention, the danger can feel much more common than it is.

Explore the [Map](map.qmd) to see recorded attack counts by country. [Trends](trends.qmd) compares fatal and non-fatal incidents across activities with at least 50 reports, leaving out incidents with unknown outcomes.
